!!! Only the butterflies whose flowers you put in the basket return to the car.

We added the Easy game mode to the menu, if you select it, butterflies will fly over 
the flowers, which, when collecting flowers and pressing the "C" ("Back" on Xbox) button, 
will return back to the car, follow them that to find a car and return the flowers.
In this mode, you will receive fewer points, but it will also be easier to play.



!!! Fixed bugs.
